title: Income and Employment Supports Act
verified_how: fetched Alberta King's Printer Laws Online catalogue entry (ISBN 9780779862320): title 'Income and Employment Supports Act', Chapter/Regulation 'S.A. 2003, c. I-0.5', Status 'Office Consolidation', Current to 7/2/2026; the Laws Online index header states 'Acts current to 2026-08-31'
notes: Alberta's income-support and training-benefits statute (Income Support, Alberta Child Health Benefit and related programs). Disability income support is a separate Act: Assured Income for the Severely Handicapped Act, S.A. 2006, c. A-45.1 (catalogue ISBN 9780779862337). Employment Insurance is federal.
